notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation, as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are this entry's own words, written from the cited sources; where a source has not yet confirmed a method (five trophies at launch), the guide says so honestly instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done. There is no extra task behind it, no multiplayer and no DLC requirement, so treat it as the finish line of this tracker rather than a trophy to chase on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours, one playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 1 is complete — PowerPyx notes it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 2 is complete, as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 3 is complete, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Chapter 4 is complete, after its final main mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final mission of the game. It is a story trophy that cannot be missed; PowerPyx ties it to the last main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run — just play the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, at Vice City International Airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The gold for the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars, do any 100 optional missions and any 70 of 80 challenges, and finish the required robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, target decks and meditations (only 15 of 18). Nothing on it is missable; everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick the easiest — PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge flights the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done. Most unlock naturally while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges; the golds are not especially hard, and they count toward the 100% checklist, so work through them during cleanup rather than at the start.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, one win per location. PowerPyx links a location guide for all 14; the races also count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so any 20 distinct wins count — pick the shortest circuits, win each once, and do not repeat a race you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline until the challenge against him unlocks.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of one game once — you do not need every challenge, just reach the end. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline (Lucia only). It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls, then is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but is available again in Chapters 2–3, so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests in order — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes — and all stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them, and says more are still being found. Character questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. All stranger strands stay available after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, steal them anywhere off the street, and deliver them in good condition for more money. Track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline (Jason only). It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This to shut the labs down for good. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2. THE only potentially missable trophy: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, disappears after Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. PowerPyx is still confirming whether that one is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — while playing as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason only). Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest and marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals he requests back to him. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 target decks, all needed for 100%. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 card set locations — pick the three sets whose cards are easiest for you to reach and finish those.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations: hold Up then R1 to scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in the world, so any 100 count — scan whatever you pass while travelling and it adds up on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Only 70 of 80 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way there. Track under Progress > Challenges — the checkmark in the bottom right shows what is done — and pick the easiest remaining ones. Most complete naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Available once you can free-roam together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break); call your partner with Right + Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — PowerPyx recommends a fast sports bike, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the flashing red/blue wanted level (not the red heat level) the whole time and loot 3 shops in a row; the pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. If it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and call your partner with Right + Triangle.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch; stand on a busy road and scan the traffic going past. Track under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 scanned base models, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar). Buff focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies — gang operations are a good spot — with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; you will likely hit it naturally at Focus level 4.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal and fly away — an unscheduled departure. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield; the easiest is at terminals E3/E4. Enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport before it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino). Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops — expect a 3-star wanted level for taking one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and the jewelry store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. It unlocks via the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (after his earlier Payday Loans quests). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break recognition. There are 8 large bank jobs total; 100% needs all 8, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as an armored truck robbery. An earlier method: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes your fence from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane and route for unfogging it quickly. PSN tracks 52 areas of Leonida.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total (yellow icons, marked as you approach them or from story progress); one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically. Track per gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Honest note: as of 18 November 2026, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no confirmed unlock method yet. The description points to a specific Ocean Beach spot: a cocktail with a view. The sensible read is a beachfront bar or viewpoint on Ocean Beach, but the exact spot is unconfirmed, so do not waste time guessing — check back once a guide confirms it. Name and description are from the official list (Exophase).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Honest note: as of 18 November 2026, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no confirmed unlock method yet. The description points to driving a car through a vehicle showroom's front window, in the style of the classic GTA opening, but the exact showroom is unconfirmed, so do not waste money guessing. Name and description are from the official list (Exophase).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) for the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup — and you do not need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Buy a fitness club membership and always train together (call your partner with Right + Triangle) — while one works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile (PSN tracks the count to 500 — click the trophy in the trophy list to see it). Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see the demon-face icon when an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho, to Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since cops get far more aggressive. It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so do not farm it until the end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Honest note: as of 18 November 2026, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Second time's the charm suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — likely a prologue Payday Loans interaction retried — but that is unconfirmed, so treat it as a lead, not a method. Name and description are from the official list (Exophase).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Honest note: as of 18 November 2026, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. What the hell just happened? fits a UFO sighting or encounter, but no location or trigger is confirmed yet. Name and description are from the official list (Exophase).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest note: as of 18 November 2026, PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. No confirmed method yet; if you try it, knock enemies down with a melee attack from a moving bike. Name and description are from the official list (Exophase).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not one delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per robbery once unlocked in Chapter 4, so this comes naturally from the robbery cleanup.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest and fastest. PowerPyx counts the shop types: 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually use and the total adds up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). Total cost $160,000. They unlock after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy through the app. Robberies fund it, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also add the parking spots you need to register vehicles for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses mission (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you summon registered stolen vehicles anywhere. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register in his garage. Initially he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
